applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Cash Reserve Ratio and Statutory Liquidity Ratio) Third Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks may optionally exempt eligible fresh NRE term deposits from CRR and SLR requirements without needing to take any mandatory positive action.
answer.action_quote: fresh Non-Resident (External) Rupee (NRE) t erm deposits of tenor of three years or more mobilized (including deposits that are renewed upon maturity) by the banks from the date of this Amendment Directions till September 30, 2026 will be exempted from maintenance of CRR and SLR

effective_date.quote: The provisions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Cash Reserve Ratio and Statutory Liquidity Ratio) Directions, 2025
